visualCharacteristics.summary: Blog article byline: round author avatar, author name and publish date, followed by circular Facebook, X, LinkedIn and WhatsApp share buttons.

contentPattern.structure: One block row; cells in any order: author photo (picture), author name (text or link), publish date (text, e.g. "Nov 20, 2025"). Optional share links (facebook/twitter/x/linkedin/whatsapp URLs); when none are authored, share links for the current page are generated for all four networks.

usage: Blog article byline: round author avatar, author name and publish date, followed by circular Facebook, X, LinkedIn and WhatsApp share buttons.

suitableFor: author/date/share line at the top of a blog article
notSuitableFor: author bio cards with long descriptions
